item: the model popup fits the panel: a tall roster scrolls its list instead of running under the header (2026-10-10)
branch: tg('modelMenu') caps #modelItems through capToRows with no row count — capToRows now clamps by the POPUP's overflow past the header's bottom (and the viewport's bottom), not the list's own box, so the header/search part of a popup counts; #modelItems scrolls (css/70-popups.css); the ✓ row is scrolled into view on open; the cap is released ('none') before every measure so a short roster never inherits a tall one's cap.
provenance: USER REPORT 2026-10-10 (screenshot, real PhpStorm 2024.2, 2.1.296's 13-row roster): the popup was taller than the panel, the filter box at its top sat under the tool-window title and could not be reached. Roster rows here are shaped like the CLI's initialize models (value / resolvedModel / displayName / description) with eight synthetic rows appended to overflow any panel height; nothing is claimed about the CLI.
